reason: The plugin is primarily a web UI desktop companion tool: it injects a Live2D RAISE A SUILEN pet into the DeepSeek Harness interface, provides interaction and costume features, and persists UI state locally, with no direct coding, automation, search, or external service workflow capabilities shown in the provided evidence.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 RAISE A SUILEN Live2D 桌宠插件，在页面中加载本地角色模型并显示可交互的看板娘，支持拖拽、换装和交互控制。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that loads local RAISE A SUILEN Live2D models in the page and displays an interactive desktop companion with drag, costume switching, and action controls.

capabilities: Renders an in-page animated Live2D character panel for user interaction
Supports drag, costume switching, and simple pet-style interactions
Serves bundled model/runtime assets from a plugin-provided static route
Persists pet display state in browser localStorage keys
Runs as a DeepSeek Harness web plugin with no external service dependency declared
